rows.meaning: physical edge of a steep place
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a literal or figurative edge when the exact setting is not specified.

example.english: The brink of the rooftop is dangerous, so don’t go so close.
example.traditional: 大廈天台嘅邊緣好危險，唔好行咁埋。
example.jyutping: daai6 haa6 tin1 toi4 ge3 bin1 jyun4 hou2 ngai4 him2 m4 hou2 haang4 gam3 maai4

rows.meaning: physical edge of a steep place
rows.note: Use this specifically for the edge of a cliff, precipice, or other steep place.

example.english: We stopped when we reached the brink of the cliff.
example.traditional: 我哋行到懸崖嘅崖邊就停低。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haang4 dou3 jyun4 ngaai4 ge3 ngaai4 bin1 zau6 ting4 dai1

rows.note: Use this for a figurative threshold or critical point, especially when a situation is about to change or break.

example.english: The economy is at the brink of collapse; if this drags on, it will collapse.
example.traditional: 經濟已經去到臨界點，再拖落去就會崩潰。
example.jyutping: ging1 zai3 ji5 ging1 heoi3 dou3 lam4 gaai3 dim2 zoi3 to1 lok6 heoi3 zau6 wui6 bang1 kui2
